title: Homology of non-matching complexes under edge additions and applications to their Stanley-Reisner ideals
summary: For a bipartite graph $G$ and an integer $t\geq2$, let $\NM_t(G)$ be its $t$-non-matching complex. We prove that adding an edge while preserving bipartiteness induces an injection on reduced homology in degree $2t-3$. Combined with the cyclic-polytope model for non-matching complexes of cycles, this shows that $\NM_t(G)$ has Leray number $2t-2$ whenever $G$ contains a cycle of length at least $2t$. Under the same hypothesis, Hochster's formula yields regularity $2t-1$ for the Stanley-Reisner ideal $I_{\NM_t(G)}$, together with explicit lower bounds for the Betti numbers on its top regularity…
